evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This call will just take around ten to fifteen minutes. Then I'll be able to build you an accurate code you can depend on sounds good.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: I'd like to ask first what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raises three concerns (reasonable price/no hidden fees, damage protection, timely completion). Nicole acknowledges each with brief responses ('Mm-hmm, I see') but does not probe deeper—e.g., no 'tell me more about that' when Sydney says 'timely manner to not rack up the bill.' Nicole pivots immediately to addressing the damage concern rather than following up on the price concern's root worry.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection. Nicole acknowledges concerns piecemeal ('I see the worry. We have a no worries damage coverage...') but never reflects back all three concerns as a consolidated summary to confirm she heard them.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment), floors (14th origin, 6th destination), rooms (2 bed/1 bed), walking distance (10 steps at origin, unclear at destination pending customer confirmation), additional rooms (second bedroom is office), special considerations (65-inch TV without original box, furniture disassembly/reassembly, donation center stop), additional stops (donation center). Nearly all seven logistics items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Do you need our help packing your small items into boxes or you'll do it yourself?
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: For a typical two bedroom apartment we usually expect to see around 25 to 35 boxes to move. Do you think you'll fall within that range?
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: For a typical two bedroom apartment it usually takes around four and a half to six hours to completely move locally... I will estimate this move to take around six to seven hours with two movers and one truck... for six to seven hours including the travel fee it's good to budget around $1,299 to $1,503. Both a typical range and personalization to this customer's specific move (14th-floor origin with reserved elevator, 6th-floor destination, donation stop).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: We charge $204 per hour... There's only one thing outside of the hourly rate, which is a one time travel fee of $75... no hidden fees of any type. No credit card fees, no assembly or reassembly fees, no stairwell fees... and the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments with a minimum of two and a half hours. Both transparency on fees and 'not a guess' framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Nicole moves immediately from the price statement ('$1,299 to $1,503 and to secure a spot there's no deposit record...') into the closing ask without a 'Does that feel fair?' checkpoint or pause.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: We have on time guarantee if we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: We have a no worries damage coverage. We provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages... no fine-print framing or explicit 'no deductible' language, but coverage amount and built-in status are clear.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Nicole does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent. She states the two promises (damage coverage and on-time guarantee) but does not confirm they answered Sydney's original concerns.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Nicole moves directly from the pricing estimate into the closing ask with no genuine 'What's still concerning you?' checkpoint.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Would you like our help with your move? When Sydney hesitates, Nicole re-asks clearly without softening it.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. No statement about rate holding or no-deposit/no-cancellation-fee reassurance tied to booking confirmation.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: None. Sydney declines ('you're a little pricey and I have to do some number crunching... it's not gonna work for me'), and Nicole does not attempt to confirm any booking details (date already set to Oct 12, but phone, arrival window, crew size, addresses, and crew notes are not confirmed).

top_strength: Nicole methodically gathered all seven logistics details (floors, distances, special items, additional stops, box count) and delivered both pricing anchors and fee transparency with concrete numbers and clear breakdowns.
coaching_note: After Sydney raised three distinct concerns at the top of the call, Nicole addressed them one-by-one without probing deeper into any of them—especially the price/hidden-fee concern, which turned out to be the deal-breaker; a second layer of questions (like 'What's your budget for this move?' or 'What would feel reasonable to you?') might have surfaced flexibility or shifted the price conversation before the estimate landed.
